title: Carve a pumpkin without the mess
author: mrdub
selftext:
A seasonal side project built on three.js's WebGPU renderer, with a WebGL2 fallback. Still optimizing so there may be some rough edges but we are getting close to Halloween :)

The pumpkin shape is parametric; you shape it with on-model grips

The carving engine does real cuts through the wall in a worker, so the pieces come out and the wall shows its thickness

The scoop is a small pulp simulation with seeds and strands

The lit scenes use a lantern light that shines out through the cuts; the garden lawn is a Gaussian-splat scan  
Photo, GIF and MP4 export happen in the browser (WebCodecs); share links are small payloads

It's been a fun exercise in keeping all of that smooth on a phone.

[https://dropdeadgourdgeous.giantaperture.com](https://dropdeadgourdgeous.giantaperture.com/)  
Happy to talk about how any part of it works.
